name: Grelin Whitebeard's Journal
summary: Grelin Whitebeard keeps a field journal in Coldridge Valley. The dwarf scout records Frostmane troll activity in its pages, until Grik'nir the Cold steals it and drags it into the troll cave.

sections.title: A Scout's Ledger
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard watches the Frostmane trolls near Coldridge Valley and records their movements in a leatherbound notebook. His field notes describe their strength, organization, and threat. Grik'nir the Cold, a heavily marked troll brute, takes the journal during a confrontation or ambush and carries it into the troll cave. Grelin needs the notes to finish his report, so he asks passing adventurers to retrieve the book.

sections.title: Dispatch to Senir
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard studies the recovered notes and judges the troll threat in Coldridge Valley temporarily contained. He uses the jottings to finish a dispatch about the Frostmane uprising. Couriers carry the sealed dispatch to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, who is stationed elsewhere in Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: Grik'nir the Cold stole Grelin Whitebeard's journal. The heavily marked Frostmane troll brute took it into the troll cave in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What is written in the journal?
faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard's journal holds his field notes on the local Frostmane trolls, their threat, and the safety of Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: What happens after the journal is recovered?
aliases: what does grelin do with the journal
faq.answer: Grelin uses his recovered notes to finish a report on the trolls. He asks an adventurer to carry it to his brother, Senir Whitebeard.

faq.q: Why is this journal so important to Grelin?
aliases: why does grelin want it back
faq.answer: Grelin needs his journal to prepare an accurate report on the Frostmane uprising for the dwarven authorities and his brother Senir. Without it, Coldridge Valley's defenses remain uncertain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, recovering Grelin's journal preserves vital intelligence on the Frostmane threat near Ironforge's training grounds.
